## Brute force search

*How much time does it take to run the algorithm for n = 16 objects?*

```{r}
knapsack_objects <- random_numbers_for_knapsack()

# Run bench::mark() once for every combination of the parameters
runs <- bench::press(
  n = c(8, 12, 16, 20),
  W = 3500,
  {
    bench::mark(brute_force_knapsack(x = knapsack_objects[1:n, ], W = W),
                filter_gc = FALSE)
  },
  .quiet = TRUE
)

# Show the results in a table
runs[, c("n", "W", "min", "median", "itr/sec", "mem_alloc")]
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
cat("It takes about", format(runs$median[runs$n == 16]), "(median)")
```

## Dynamic programming

*How much time does it take to run the algorithm for n = 500 objects?*

```{r}
res_dynamic <- bench::mark(knapsack_dynamic(x = knapsack_objects[1:500, ], W = 3500),
                           filter_gc = FALSE)

res_dynamic[, c("min", "median", "itr/sec", "mem_alloc")]
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
cat("It takes about", format(res_dynamic$median), "(median)")
```

## Greedy heuristic

*How much time does it take to run the algorithm for n = 1,000,000 objects?*

```{r}
knapsack_objects_large <- suppressWarnings(random_numbers_for_knapsack(n = 1e6))

res_greed <- bench::mark(greedy_knapsack(x = knapsack_objects_large, W = 3500),
                         filter_gc = FALSE)

res_greed[, c("min", "median", "itr/sec", "mem_alloc")]
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
cat("It takes about", format(res_greed$median), "(median)")
```

## Profiling and optimizing the code

*What performance gain could you get by trying to improve your code?*

Base R (`a`) vs tidyverse (`b`) versions, relative to the fastest (= 1).

```{r}
compare_functions(greedy_knapsack, greedy_knapsack_tidyverse,
                  args = list(x = knapsack_objects_large, W = 3500))$timings

compare_functions(brute_force_knapsack, brute_force_knapsack_tidyverse,
                  args = list(x = knapsack_objects[1:12, ], W = 3500))$timings
```

Brute force keeping only the best so far (`a`) vs saving all combinations in a data.frame (`b`).

```{r}
compare_functions(brute_force_knapsack, brute_force_knapsack_df,
                  args = list(x = knapsack_objects[1:12, ], W = 3500))$timings
```

Brute force with a loop (`a`) vs all combinations as a 0/1 matrix and matrix products (`b`).

```{r}
compare_functions(brute_force_knapsack, brute_force_knapsack_matrix,
                  args = list(x = knapsack_objects[1:12, ], W = 3500))$timings
```
